corpus.note: one match; the chain is per-clip and scales linearly with clips, videos and cores

fitted_from.note: engine parameters are a pure function of metrics.json; agents are 1:1 with measured players

v_max.note: measured top speed enters the motion envelope unchanged

acc.note: acceleration envelope from measured accel load and sprint count

pass_acc.note: delivery accuracy from coordination score and joint kinematics

pass_range.note: range from measured ankle push-off and explosiveness

vision.note: scan rate drives selection temperature: tau = 1/(0.5 + 1.5·vision)

risk.note: forward-value appetite in the expected-value term

dribble.note: change-of-direction peak and coordination drive carry retention

carry_bias.note: appetite to run with the ball, from speed and high-speed distance

finish.note: finisher coefficient: shifts logit(xg) for the shot lane

intercept.note: line-of-sight reactivity is the interception coefficient in p_int

control.note: coordination and joint kinematics are the retention coefficient in p_ctl

perceive.note: scan and line-of-sight reactivity drive p_perceive

projection.rule: each player's two weakest trainable metrics are advanced by 0.6 cohort SD; every other metric is held at its measured value and the SAME fit function is re-run
projection.caveat: a stated planning assumption, not an observed training response

factors.formula: sigmoid(base + acc - d/range - w_p*press - w_l*lane + w_c*ctl - fwd*d/20)

factors.gloss: the opponent takes it off the lane

showcase.rule: candidate seeds are those whose xg percentile lies inside [0.30, 0.70] on BOTH the before and after distributions and which yield at least one shot on both sides — i.e. representative of each marginal, not best-case. Among the 48 candidates closest to the median, the chosen seed is the one whose two decision streams diverge most, so the split screen shows two genuinely different possessions. Divergence is direction-neutral: it selects for difference, never for which side does better. Both runs use the same seed.
showcase.label: one sampled possession
showcase.note: ONE sampled possession, shown for legibility, chosen to be typical of both distributions on both headline channels. The before/after CLAIM is sim.json.ensemble, not this run. Scenes must label it as a single sample.

ensemble.note: the same seeds against both parameter sets; per-run means with the standard error of the PAIRED difference. A delta whose |mean| does not exceed 1.96·sem is not a result.

parity.note: summary re-derived from this run's own serialised event stream and compared with the live accumulator
